items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Tommy Dawson was never heard of yet and all that stuff.

ctx.x: Good Lord. You must have been making some money at that place then.

Why? I could have bumped my head. You see, I'm a young kid, you don't know, you know what they, well, you see, I was raided in Chicago. Yeah. You understand? Tommy Dawson was never heard of yet and all that stuff. But then just like New Orleans, I was raided here. Would you believe I got more money than all the musicians? Oh yeah. Instead of the lead item. I always got $25 or $50. So when I was working at the Palace Theater, you don't remember the Little Club, like before your time I think.
I heard of it that time.
